🇲🇽🌎 <u>POPE LEO XIV'S MEXICO VISIT: INVITATION STANDS, NO DATE YET</u>

Sheinbaum confirmed the details of her Palacio Nacional meeting with Vatican Secretary of State Pietro Parolin: the invitation for Pope Leo XIV to visit Mexico stands, but there is still no date — the Vatican is prioritizing a November tour of Peru, Argentina and Uruguay first. A secular Mexican state dealing with the Holy See on equal footing. Diplomacy without kneeling.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>EXPERT PANEL RULES OUT FRACKING IN TAMPICO-MISANTLA BASIN</u>

The expert committee reviewing unconventional gas in Mexico recommended banning fracking in the Tampico-Misantla basin between Veracruz and southern Tamaulipas. Only Sabinas-Burro-Picachos (Coahuila-Nuevo León) and Burgos remain under evaluation — and the first step there is drilling water wells to map the aquifers before any gas project moves. Energy sovereignty with environmental locks, decided by Mexican scientists instead of the companies that bought their permits for decades.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>MEXICO'S CONGRESS HOLDS MINUTE OF SILENCE FOR PALESTINIANS KILLED BY ISRAEL</u>

The Permanent Commission of Mexico's Congress stood in silence for the thousands of Palestinians killed by Israel's army, on a Morena proposal by deputy María Magdalena Rosales — the same week Gaza buried 112 people whose bodies spent three years beneath the rubble of their homes in Sabra. "It is also a minute of silence for peace and against the war in the Middle East," said commission president Laura Itzel Castillo. Mexico's lawmakers name the genocide what it is while Washington keeps arming it.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>OLIGARCHY LOBBIES AGAINST BATRES FOR SUPREME COURT PRESIDENCY</u>

President Sheinbaum confirmed it herself: a group of businessmen met with her at Palacio Nacional two months ago to lobby against Minister Lenia Batres leading the Supreme Court starting September 2027. "There are businessmen who propose one person or another, not necessarily Lenia Batres — but that is a matter for the Court," she said. Mexicans elected their judges at the ballot box; the oligarchy still thinks justice is negotiated behind closed doors at the President's house.

🇲🇽💰 <u>BANXICO HOLDS AT 6.50% — SECOND STRAIGHT PAUSE</u>

Banco de México kept its reference rate at 6.50% today, its second consecutive hold, with analysts now expecting the pause to last the rest of the year — El Financiero describes "three padlocks" on any near-term cut. The backdrop: inflation down to 3.1% in early July, the lowest since 2020, and the peso trading around 17.25 per dollar. Macro stability the business press spent years predicting Mexico could never sustain.

🗺️ Mexico holds an estimated 141.5 trillion cubic feet of non-conventional gas. "The potential of natural gas from non-conventional fields is estimated at 141.5 trillion cubic feet, distributed mainly in three basins: Burgos, Sabinas-Burro-Picachos and Tampico-Misantla." — Ana Paulina Gómora, UNAM Faculty of Engineering This is a "prospective resource" estimate — exploratory wells and reservoir studies are still needed to convert it into proven reserves and test economic viability.

🔥 Ending gas flaring alone could recover up to 2.4 billion cubic feet per day. "Pemex must develop a plan to increase the gas supply with conventional production and avoid burning that resource in oil fields." — Alma América Porres Luna, hydrocarbons expert The committee estimates up to 2,400 MMcf/d from eliminating flaring, plus up to 4,700 MMcf/d from conventional fields in Burgos, Tampico-Misantla, Veracruz and the southeast basins.
